title: Sebulba
description: Sebulba was a Dug podracer. He considered young Anakin Skywalker an easy opponent to beat headed into the Boonta Eve Classic on Tatooine. As the race got underway, Sebulba deployed a number of measures to take out other racers. He tried to take Anakin out of the race, but in the end, he was the one in a field of debrias and Anakin was the champion.
